description: This header file defines utility functions, macros, and data structures related to controller configuration, ALE (Access Local Element) state management, radio and channel handling, and other mapping operations for a wireless network controller. It provides function declarations and inline implementations to manage ALE nodes, update radio and interface configurations, and parse network messages.

methods.name: void map_update_ale_source_mac(map_ale_info_t * ale,uint8_t * src_mac)
methods.description: Inline function that copies a MAC address to the source MAC of an ALE node.

methods.name: map_update_ale_receiving_iface
methods.description: Function to update the receiving interface name for an ALE node.

methods.name: map_recompute_radio_state_and_update_ale_state
methods.description: Function to recalculate the onboard state of an ALE node based on radio status bits.

methods.name: map_reset_agent_node_onboarding_status
methods.description: Function to reset a single ALE node's onboarding status.

methods.name: map_reset_all_agent_nodes_onboarding_status
methods.description: Function to reset onboarding status for all ALE nodes.

methods.name: map_convert_mapunits_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a value from map units to bytes based on the unit type.

methods.name: map_scan_status_to_string
methods.description: Converts a scan status code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: map_scan_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts a scan type code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: map_find_radio_by_supported_channel
methods.description: Finds the first radio supporting a specific channel.

methods.name: map_get_freq_bands
methods.description: Returns the supported frequency bands of a radio.

methods.name: map_is_5g_low_high
methods.description: Checks if the radio is 5GHz and supports both low and high bands.

methods.name: map_get_profile_from_bss
methods.description: Guesses the profile used for BSS configuration.

methods.name: map_radio_has_profile_with_bss_state
methods.description: Checks whether a radio has a profile with a specific BSS state.

methods.name: map_get_wsc_attr
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from a WSC message.

methods.name: map_is_channel_in_cap_op_class
methods.description: Checks if a channel is supported in a given operational class.

methods.name: map_get_channel_pref
methods.description: Gets the preference value for a channel within an op class list.

methods.name: map_update_radio_channels
methods.description: Updates the supported channels of a radio based on configuration and capabilities.

methods.name: map_merge_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Merges two operational class lists, taking the lowest preference.

methods.name: map_optimize_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Removes channel lists that encompass all channels of an op class to optimize preference.

methods.name: map_is_no_subband_channel_set
methods.description: Checks if a subband channel set does not contain specific channels.

methods.name: map_is_all_subband_channel_set
methods.description: Checks if all channels of a subband are present in a channel set.

methods.name: map_sort_op_class_list
methods.description: Sorts operational classes and channels within a list for consistency.

methods.name: map_is_cac_request_valid
methods.description: Validates if a CAC (Channel Access Check) request on a radio and channel is valid.

methods.name: map_find_local_iface
methods.description: Finds the local interface associated with a given ALE based on MAC address.

methods.name: map_find_bhsta_iface_from_ale
methods.description: Finds backhaul station interface from an ALE node based on MAC.

methods.name: map_find_bhsta_iface_gbl
methods.description: Globally finds a backhaul station interface by MAC, returning associated ALE.

methods.name: map_free_ht_vht_he_wifi6_caps
methods.description: Deletes HT, VHT, HE, and WiFi6 capability TLVs from radio information.

methods.name: map_update_radio_caps
methods.description: Updates radio capabilities from capability TLVs.
